name: b6307-masjid
prompt: Vertical 9:16 photoreal cinematic, inside a very simple 7th-century Arabian mosque with no decoration at all: rows of rough unworked date-palm trunks used as pillars holding a low flat roof of palm leaves laid over palm trunks and beaten clay, walls of sun-dried mud brick on a low stone base, plain sand floor. The roof covers only part of the enclosure and opens onto a bright sunlit open courtyard; warm sunlight falls in thin beams through small gaps in the palm-leaf roof. Empty, quiet, bright. No people, no mihrab, no niche, no minaret, no dome, no carpets, no lamps, no calligraphy, no text, no modern objects.
